resources.string: Cancel phone verification
Continue as guest
A guest uses a Firebase account and needs internet. Link it later to keep this identity across reinstalls.
Continue locally
Local mode does not sign in or create an account. Pairing and cloud features need authentication.

Sign-out and account switching are unavailable in this release on both Parent and Child devices. They require a separate safe migration design for offline cloud queues and local device profiles. Linking keeps the same account.
This installation is bound to its original account. Recover that same account using a linked sign-in method, or continue locally. A new account or guest identity cannot replace it.

The current account does not match this installation’s bound identity. Authentication changes are blocked; this existing session was not switched or signed out. Continue locally and recover the original account through a safe recovery process.

The selected account does not match this installation’s bound identity. Only that new sign-in was rolled back to the previous signed-out state. Recover the original account or continue locally. No migration or guest fallback was performed.
Please wait…
Please wait for the current account operation to finish before leaving.
Authentication completed.
Provider linked. This device’s account identity is unchanged.
If this address has a password account, a reset email has been requested. Check your inbox and spam folder.
Verification email requested. Check your inbox and spam folder, then check verification here.
Email is not verified yet. Open the verification link, then check again.
Requesting verification. A browser or app-verification prompt may appear.
Verification started. Enter the SMS code, or wait for automatic verification.
Automatic verification has stopped. You can still enter a received code, resend after the cooldown, or cancel and start again.
Phone verification cancelled. Any SMS cooldown still applies.
Google sign-in cancelled. Tap the button to try again.
No Google credential is available. Add or select a Google account in the chooser, or use email/phone instead.
Google sign-in is unavailable on this device. Check Google Play services and Credential Manager, or use email/phone.
Enter a valid email address.
Enter your password. Spaces are not removed.
Use at least 8 characters to create or link a password.
Enter a phone number starting with + and its country code, using 2–15 digits with no spaces.
Read and accept the SMS, privacy, and possible charges notice before requesting verification.
Enter exactly six ASCII digits (0–9), without spaces.
The credentials or verification code could not be accepted. Check them and try again.

Those credentials belong to another account. This device’s existing identity has been kept. Automatic merging or replacing the account is not supported. Use a new provider identity that is not already linked elsewhere.
This address or credential is already associated with an account, possibly using another sign-in method. Try its original method. Accounts are not merged automatically.
This sign-in method is not enabled for this Firebase project. Ask the app administrator to enable it. You can continue locally.
Authentication setup is incomplete. Check the app’s Firebase configuration, enabled providers, signing fingerprints, and app verification. You can continue locally.

Google setup is required: the consuming app must generate default_web_client_id for a Web OAuth client. Enable Google in Firebase and update that app’s configuration. No client ID is embedded in this library.
Could not reach the authentication service. Check your connection and retry, or continue locally when not signed in.
Too many requests or the SMS quota has been reached. Wait before trying again. Repeated requests will not bypass the limit.
This password does not meet the project’s password policy. Use at least 8 characters and follow any additional policy requirements.
This action requires a recent confirmation of the existing account. Its identity has not been replaced. Confirm your existing email/password if available, then retry.
The verification session has expired. Request another SMS after the cooldown.
This account is disabled. Contact the app administrator; this screen will not replace its identity.
The account changed while this operation was open. The operation was stopped instead of switching or merging identities. Reopen this screen to try again.
This provider is already connected. It cannot be linked again or replaced here.
Authentication could not be completed. Please try again. No account merge was attempted.
Confirm existing email/password
Existing account confirmed. Its identity is unchanged.
